summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Eyal Golan, an Israeli singer working in the Mizrahi style. It describes him as one of the most successful singers of that genre in Israel and notes that he reported the highest income of any singer in Israel in 2011.
one_line: Eyal Golan is an Israeli Mizrahi singer, considered one of the genre's most successful performers and the top-earning singer in Israel in 2011.
key_facts: Eyal Golan was born Eyal Biton on April 12, 1971.
Eyal Golan is an Israeli singer.
Eyal Golan sings in the Mizrahi style.
Eyal Golan is considered one of the most successful singers of the Mizrahi genre in Israel.
Eyal Golan reported the highest income of all singers in Israel in 2011.
